subject: SaturnX onboarding: staging gate override & rollback policy
messages:
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Samir Patel <samir@acme.ai>
Cc: 
Bcc: 
Date: 2027-05-22T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: SaturnX onboarding: staging gate override & rollback policy

Team / Samir —

Quick context: Acme AI is ready to move SaturnX (a high-throughput dialogue model) into our staging environment tomorrow. They are asking to bypass the usual 72-hour staging hold due to a demo timeline next week. I want to propose a controlled override so we support the partner without taking on undue risk.

Ask: approve a temporary staging-gate override for SaturnX with the following mandatory controls:
- Pin the serving variant to "saturnx-compat-v1" for the initial rollout (no auto-upgrades for 48 hours)
- Canary to 5% traffic in staging for 6 hours, then 25% for 18 hours if no regressions
- Enable verbose telemetry export (see attached sample) and three smoke tests (latency p50/p95, token correctness on 10 QA prompts, memory/KV stability)
- Fast rollback policy: if any of the telemetry thresholds cross the configured SLOs, immediate rollback to the last known-good variant (explicitly documented)

Risks I want us to acknowledge: quantization mismatch on our optimized kernels, spike in KV cache usage due to longer contexts, and potential hallucination regressions not covered by unit evals.

Samir — can Acme sign the attached limited-risk addendum (DocuSign link in my next message) and confirm they can run their own smoke harness in staging?

If people are aligned I will mark this as an exception to our 72-hour staging hold and create an INF ticket for auditing. I need a yes/no in the next 3 hours to meet Acme's schedule.

Thanks,
David
David Kim
Head of Product Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachments: saturnx-model-summary.pdf (model spec, size: 12.4GB), saturnx-telemetry-sample.json (sample telemetry), docsign-onboard-agreement.pdf (limited-risk addendum)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Samir Patel <samir@acme.ai>
Date: 2027-05-22T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SaturnX onboarding: staging gate override & rollback policy

David — thanks for the clear ask. A couple of follow-ups from product-evals side:
- We need the model's eval suite results (safety checks, QA set pass rates, and latency distribution) attached to the onboarding packet. The saturnx-model-summary has high-level numbers but we need the raw scores to validate our automated regressions.
- Confirm whether the vendor is okay with our prefix/KV telemetry hooks (we anonymize user prompts) — that's required for root-cause on hallucination regressions.

If those two items are provided by EOD, I'm comfortable with the temporary override under the traffic and rollback limits you outlined.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Lead, Model Safety & Evals
Redwood Inference

From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Samir Patel <samir@acme.ai>
Date: 2027-05-22T11:21:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SaturnX onboarding: staging gate override & rollback policy

Short technical note from infra/runtime: we can support the override but need to lock these knobs before enabling traffic:
- Quantization profile: we'll only allow our tested int8 pathway for this variant. If Acme requires a different quant, they must provide a validated artifact.
- Kernel selection: SaturnX uses a long-context attention kernel we haven't stressed at 25% staging traffic; request we keep max sequence length capped at 2048 for the initial rollout.
- Pin behavior: we will implement the pin by adding a variant-level label "pin:manual-override-dk-20270522". This prevents auto-roll forward but still allows explicit operator rollback.

I will open an internal INF change with the exact commands; please approve the staged traffic windows (5%/25%) and the 2048 max-seq constraint.

Dev
Dev Patel
Principal SRE, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference

From: Samir Patel <samir@acme.ai>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-22T12:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SaturnX onboarding: staging gate override & rollback policy

Thanks for the fast turn. We can do the Evals export and grant the telemetry hooks you requested — we just need to confirm a couple procurement items before DocuSign:
- We need a 30-day trial invoice term (standard for partnerships) and confirmation this override does not change the billing baseline.
- We will sign the limited-risk addendum if the DocuSign link is sent today.

We will also provide a condensed eval export (safety + QA + latency) within 4 hours. We confirm max sequence length <= 2048 is fine for the demo.

—Samir
Samir Patel
Head of Partnerships
Acme AI

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Samir Patel <samir@acme.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-24T15:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SaturnX onboarding: staging gate override & rollback policy — final plan

Following the uploads from Acme and internal checks, ops is approving the controlled override with the conditions below:
- Pin variant: "saturnx-compat-v1" will be labeled "pin:manual-override-dk-20270522" and locked for 48 hours.
- Canary schedule: 5% for 6 hours (smoke checks at 30m, 3h, 6h), then 25% for 18 hours if all smoke checks pass.
- Telemetry: we will run the verbose ingest, and Eval team will run the regression harness every 6 hours for the first 24 hours.
- Rollback triggers (examples): p95 latency > 2.5x baseline, memory/KV errors increase by >30%, or QA pass-rate drop >5% on the agreed dataset. Any single trigger causes immediate rollback.
- DocuSign: procurement confirms the limited-risk addendum is acceptable; Samir, please countersign the DocuSign today. Link: https://docusign.com/exec/ACME-SaturnX

Post-rollout: INF-3427 will capture the audit (who toggled pin, timestamps, telemetry snapshots). Please ensure the 48-hour lock is respected; we will schedule a handoff meeting on Monday to review telemetry and decide next steps.

Approving: Laura Bennett
Laura Bennett
VP, Production Operations
Redwood Inference

On behalf of the runbook, INF-3427 (https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-3427) will be updated with the exact emergency rollback commands and contact list.
